content.short: The Tipsy Turtles is an animated series for the Cardano NFT scene.
content.description: The Tipsy Turtles is an animated series for the Cardano NFT scene. It features two characters - Ted and Tony the Turtle and their interactions with over 20 of Cardano's most beloved PFP projects. Minting a Tipsy Turtle will also give you access to TripHut. The Tipsy Turtles IP will manifest at the onset as digital collectibles on the Cardano Blockchain, supported by animated content. In the lead up to mint, the project will be releasing a 36-episode animated series for the Cardano NFT scene using some of the blockchain’s favorite characters the characters.
content.meta: Find out about Tipsy Turtles (NFT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
